title: Synthetic Data Generator
summary: A web application (React frontend plus Python backend) that lets a user upload a CSV, train a generative model, and download synthetic data. Its backend tries SDV's CTGANSynthesizer (falling back to standalone ctgan or a statistical generator) to fit tabular data and generate synthetic rows, using SDV's metadata schema and mode-specific normalization via CTGAN.
